verdict.rationale: Granola's docs say the mobile app takes AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings (and phone calls on iOS), with transcription in 17 languages on iOS and Android. Community testers corroborate the mobile/watch capture experience. Notes are searchable and queryable across all meetings via Chat and MCP, and live within personal and team spaces. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that mobile-captured notes sync into the same workspace as desktop notes, and a documented keyword search UI as opposed to Chat/MCP querying.
